question: How do I publish my Fern Go SDK to pkg.go.dev?
ground_truth: To publish your Fern Go SDK to pkg.go.dev, you need to configure your generators.yml file to point to your GitHub repository instead of using output/config properties, ensure your repository is public with an approved license, generate a release using 'fern generate --group go-sdk --version <version>', and then navigate to pkg.go.dev with your repository URL to request indexing of your package.

metadata.cited_context: Configure `output` location: Go publishes via Git repositories, so remove the auto-generated `output` and `config` properties. Instead, add the path to your GitHub repository. Generate your release: Regenerate your SDK and publish it on pkg.go.dev: `fern generate --group go-sdk --version <version>`. Publish on pkg.go.dev: Navigate to `https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/<github-org>/<github-repo-name>/` and send a request to index your package.
